kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تعتذرين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَذِرِينَ (taʕtaḏirīna) /taʕ.ta.ði.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# تُعْتَذَرِينَ (tuʕtaḏarīna) /tuʕ.ta.ða.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
